rubric_items.deep_module: pass — no new module is introduced; §16 renders the SEARCH predicate through the existing build_vector_search and the index DDL through GraphClient.ensure_vector_indexes, and §17 extends the one label-parameterised embed_worker rather than adding a parallel worker.

rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — every implementable section names the mechanism it extends at file level (§12's vector_index_filters annotation and GraphClient.ensure_vector_indexes for §16; embed_worker.py and reset.py for §17; the discover paths/code scoping option for §14; probe_remote_environment and persist the existing DataAccess writer for §9), and §17 cites the claimed_at cutoff shape as prior art.
